status: Implementation specification; compiler sources were inspected read-only, not modified
problem: Rust republishes synthetic builtin trait names as module-qualified nominal identities, copies that complete union into every module registry, then copies it again into every ModuleState

rust_sites.role: Every module gets synthetic builtin auto-trait names, even when its source declares no nominal types
Qualifies all six sets without restricting them to actual local nominal declarations; merges the growing union into every registry
nominal_identity formats an identity for any supplied name, without checking whether that declaration exists
Six extend(iter().cloned()) operations allocate owned HashSet tables and owned strings
Copies the already-expanded module registry sets a second time into every ModuleState; retains both collections during checking

jet_sites.role: symbol_id is an identity formatter, but is not fed a per-module union of synthetic builtin names
Nominal registration creates rows for actual nominal AST declarations; unmatched item kinds return None
One graph owns indexes of actual nominal rows; no six per-module canonical union sets
Err, Ordering and RemoveBy are injected once each into a selected owner module, not once into every module
Computes Printable/Debug/Equatable selection from one resolved declaration and the owning module's explicit impl map
Resolves the real owner before consulting Printable metadata
Resolves the real owner before consulting Debug metadata
Resolves the real owner before consulting Equatable metadata
Equatable/Comparable candidate maps are local to the module's actual declarations, not a copied bundle union
FixSelfA's existing pass environment is reused across modules; module results retain only source_module.nominals and module-local metadata
The environment takes ownership of one graph copy and resets module-specific fields in place

self_compile_conclusion: This specific Rust union-copy defect is not present in the live Jet source and therefore is not a source-level explanation of the live jetc0 286-module self-compile. The separate Jet whole-graph environment-copy defect was already removed by FixSelfA. No dynamic Jet-port timing was performed in this investigation.

shared_contract.ownership: One immutable canonical trait-fact table per bundle/registration-graph version. Module registries retain only their own bare-name/local facts and a shared handle or borrowed reference to the canonical table.
shared_contract.identity: Canonical facts are keyed by a resolved actual nominal declaration identity, never by qualifying arbitrary builtin names with each consumer module's identity. Synthetic builtin facts have one compiler-owned table/predicate and do not multiply with empty modules.
shared_contract.queries: Resolve source aliases, visibility and shadowing to the owner first. Query by the already-resolved owner/declaration key. Local derive expansion iterates only the owner's local selections. Do not allocate or flatten a union to satisfy a query or a codegen consumer.
shared_contract.invalidation: Recompute at registration/graph-version boundaries after declarations or marker/impl inputs change, not per module, body, query, or generated consumer.
shared_contract.complexity: Retained facts and publication work must be O(actual nominal facts + module count + fixed builtin facts), not O(module count * published facts).

rust_changes: Introduce a canonical auto-trait facts object for Printable, Debug, Equatable, Comparable, Encode and Decode, frozen once per bundle after the existing structural fixed point. Arc-share it across TraitRegistry/ModuleState and later semantic consumers. Keep existing local selections separate and module-local.

At Traits.rs:341-361 publish only actual owner declarations: intersect selected local names with the registry's local nominal declarations and the name ledger's real type declaration rows before obtaining a canonical identity. Do not publish names merely because register_synthetic_display_debug inserted them. Preserve a real user/Core declaration that happens to have a builtin spelling.

Do not change the generic formatting behavior of NameLedger::nominal_identity blindly: audit its callers and enforce real-declaration membership at publication, or introduce a declaration-validated nominal identity query for that operation. Formatting an unresolved name must never create a trait fact.

Remove the global extend/cloned loop at Traits.rs:363-365. Replace CheckInner.rs:1634 with attaching the shared canonical handle and transferring/merging only that module's local selections. No second full union is permitted; temporary bundle_auto_derives results must not retain duplicate global tables.

Replace global-membership uses of auto_derive_set/direct HashSet access with a non-allocating has_auto_derive(trait, resolved owner/declaration) query that consults local facts, the canonical shared facts, and compiler-owned builtin facts correctly. Provide local-only iteration for derive/serde expansion; do not return an allocated local-plus-global set.

Migrate consumers in Traits.rs:1785-1804 and 2049-2074; jet-sema SchemaMigration.rs, Registration/Derives.rs, Registration/Serde.rs and CheckerInfer/stdlib_lints/display_lint.rs. Update App.rs:22 and GateLedger.rs:199 to reuse the frozen bundle facts rather than independently rebuilding a replicated Vec<TraitRegistry>.

Audit jet-codegen/Codegen/Context.rs:6631-6634 and TIR/mod.rs:5063-5066,5452-5454: codegen needs selections for actual owned types, not a copied bundle union in every Cx or per-module metadata map. Publish per-type TIR/MIR trait flags from the shared canonical answer, or retain the shared query handle; preserve schema and generated derive behavior.
jet_changes: Do not add the Rust union-copy architecture: the port already avoids it. Retain FixSelfA's one environment per pass and borrowed module/function checking.

For a common once-per-bundle facts boundary, add a frozen trait-fact table/index to the graph-pass environment, keyed by existing registered nominal SymbolID keys or nominal row positions. Build it once from actual graph.modules[*].nominals and owning-module impl/marker inputs. Empty modules contribute no nominal facts; compiler-owned builtins retain their one existing owner or a fixed builtin predicate.

Cache the existing TypeMetadata.jet:108-126 selection answers once per resolved nominal and graph version. Route Literals.jet:766-780, Calls/Direct.jet:154-166 and Comparability.jet:89-106 through the borrowed owner-keyed table rather than recomputing declaration fields/impl membership at each query. Preserve current trait-selection semantics; this is not permission to add new language capabilities.

Keep Derives.jet's local candidate maps local. If consolidating their Equatable/Comparable solved answers with the canonical table, compute each owner's rows once and have local derive/serde expansion consume only those rows; never copy every owner's rows into each module's registration/module-result records.

Thread the one facts object by borrow through CheckProgram.jet:1535-1545 and Scopes.jet:518-548. Do not store a value copy in each SemaGraphModuleResult or nominal query context. Refresh only when the source registration graph version changes, including comptime specialization/marker input changes.

Continue obtaining identities from the resolved registration row. The generic Types.jet:341 formatter is not a declaration existence test; call sites must not synthesize builtin trait identities for each empty consumer module.
acceptance: An empty-module ladder must not increase canonical builtin fact cardinality. A bundle with no source nominals has only fixed compiler/Core nominal facts, independent of its empty module count.

A bundle containing T real nominal declarations and M consumer modules stores O(T + M) trait metadata; all consumers share the same canonical object. A pointer-identity/reference-ownership assertion or deterministic published-fact/table-copy counters should establish that there is one global table, not M copies.

Preserve qualified/grouped imports, private/public visibility, duplicate leaf names across files/packages, builtin-name shadowing, negative markers, explicit impl suppression, package auto-derive defaults, generic structural bounds, and recursive structural fixed-point behavior. Cover actual imported Core error types as well as empty modules.

Run the module scaling gate at baseline 1 and 64/128/256, plus a many-nominal/many-consumer fixture. Compare heaptrack allocation stacks before/after: merge_auto_derives must not retain whole-union HashSet or string-copy allocation sites per module. Check and build must have consistent canonical answers.
Main verifies compiler tests/builds only after both compiler halves and all callers land; this task did not edit or build compiler sources.

observed_evidence.note: Heaptrack's reported peak consumption per site is not a cumulative-allocation-byte metric. Reports were generated with backtrace merging disabled. /proc sampling for 256 completes the requested 64/128/256 breakdown without needing a 256-module heaptrack process under the small lane.
